verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack covers AI-training data use, such as a no-training policy, an opt-out setting, or data-use terms for the hosted or public relay. Self-hosting a private CDN and end-to-end encryption are related privacy controls, but they are not a documented guarantee or opt-out against model training, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
